facts.fact: BCEAO's Avis n°0019 of 2 October 2026 makes its PI-SPI platform mandatory from 2 November 2026 for interoperable e-money transactions in the UEMOA including Benin.
The article says PI-SPI is a BCEAO regional platform covering the eight UEMOA states including Benin, in force from 2 November 2026.
